user.title: New timer
user.description: Give the timer a name and set the default duration, the expiry sound and the actions to run. The name becomes the device name; each entity gets its own name from it. Leave the media player empty for no sound.

error.name_exists: A timer with this name already exists.

init.title: Timer settings
init.description: Renaming does not change the entity IDs. The default duration overrides the sliders only when it is changed here; a value set on the sliders (or with the set service) survives a restart. The sound and the actions only run on expiry, inside the time window.

error.name_exists: A timer with this name already exists.

no_duration.message: At least one of hours, minutes or seconds is required.

zero_duration.message: The duration must be longer than zero.

start.name: Start
start.description: Starts the countdown timer. Without a duration it uses the values of the Hours / Minutes / Seconds entities. A running timer is overwritten. The expiry sound and actions can be passed at start (the card does this); anything you leave out falls back to the integration settings. Execution happens on the server, so the card may be closed at expiry.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: Hours part (0-24). If any of the duration fields is given, the missing ones count as zero.

media_player.name: Media player
media_player.description: The media player for the expiry sound. If you provide it (even empty), it decides for this run: empty means no sound, and the integration setting does not apply.

sound_file.name: Sound file
sound_file.description: The media ID to play (e.g. /local/...). Empty uses the default file.

sound_after.name: Sound and actions after
sound_after.description: Start of the time window. Outside the window neither the sound nor the actions run.

sound_before.name: Sound and actions until
sound_before.description: End of the time window. If the start and the end are the same, there is no time limit.

actions.name: Actions on expiry
actions.description: Actions to run on expiry, using the standard Home Assistant action syntax. Empty means no actions, only the sound.

set.name: Set default duration
set.description: Sets the default duration without starting. The same as changing the Hours / Minutes / Seconds entities. At least one value is required.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Pauses the running timer. Does nothing if it is not running.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Resumes the paused timer from the remaining time.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Cancels the timer and puts it into the idle state.
